For example, a signal of stop urgent cat returns a formatted message with a period and a capitalized Cat, along with an integer cost of one.

title: Vinyl Record Pressing Quality Control
spec: Assess the manufacturing quality of pressed vinyl records. Write the function `inspect(records)` taking a list of tuples, where each tuple contains an integer weight, an integer warp angle, and a boolean for scratches. Loop through the items. If the weight is below one hundred and thirty grams or the warp exceeds five degrees, mark it as rejected. If the weight is exactly one hundred and forty grams with no scratches, mark it perfect. If scratches exist but the weight exceeds one hundred and eighty grams, mark it for discount. If the weight exceeds two hundred grams, mark it for recycling. If the warp angle is negative, record a machine calibration error. If it fits no specific category, mark it as standard. If the total rejected count exceeds ten, halt the inspection loop early. For example, a tuple of 140 weight, 0 warp, and false scratches returns a perfect count of one.

title: Lockpicking Tumbler Simulator
spec: Simulate picking a pin tumbler lock. Write the function `pick(actions)` taking a list of integer tension actions. Loop through the applied tensions. If the tension is exactly five, increment the set tumbler count. If the tension is strictly greater than ten, set a broken pick flag and break the loop. If the tension is less than two, reset all currently set tumblers to zero. If the tension is exactly seven, set two tumblers at once. If the tension is negative, ignore the action. If the tumbler count reaches exactly five, set a success flag and terminate. If consecutive identical tension actions are applied, subtract one from the set count due to over-manipulation. If the tumbler count exceeds five, the lock jams and fails. For example, the input list 5, 5, 5, 5, 5 returns a boolean of true for success.

title: Basic CPU Emulator
spec: Emulate a basic arithmetic processor. Write the function `execute(program)` taking a list of string instructions. Maintain an integer accumulator starting at zero and a program counter. Loop through the instructions using the counter. If the instruction is add, increase the accumulator by five. If the instruction is subtract, decrease the accumulator by three. If the instruction is jump, skip the next instruction by advancing the counter an extra step. If the instruction is halt, terminate execution immediately. If the instruction is multiply, double the accumulator. If the accumulator exceeds two hundred and fifty five, reset it to zero. If the accumulator becomes strictly negative, reset it to zero. If the instruction is completely unrecognized, skip it without modifying the accumulator. For example, an input of add jump subtract add returns an integer of ten.

title: Podcast Episode Segmenter
spec: Analyze timestamps to segment a podcast episode. Write the function `segment(timestamps)` taking a list of integer markers in seconds. Loop through the list to analyze the gaps between consecutive markers. If a marker is negative, discard it. If the gap between the current marker and the previous is less than ten seconds, merge them by ignoring the current one. If the gap is greater than thirty six hundred seconds, increment a chapter break counter. If the marker falls exactly on a multiple of six hundred seconds, increment an advertisement counter. If the total elapsed time exceeds ten thousand seconds, stop processing further markers. If two consecutive gaps are identical in length, flag the section as a potential musical interlude. If the list is entirely empty, return zeros for all counts. If a marker is exactly zero, treat it as the intro and do not calculate a gap. For example, markers at 0, 8, 3610 return one chapter break and zero ads.

title: Chemical Formula Mass
spec: Calculate the molecular mass of a chemical compound string. Write the function `weigh(formula)` taking a single string. Loop through the characters. If the character is an uppercase letter, start a new element token. If the character is a lowercase letter, append it to the current element token. If the character is a digit, parse it as a multiplier for the current element. If the character is an open bracket, ignore it. If the character is a closing bracket, double the mass of the next element processed. If the parsed element is carbon, add twelve to the total mass. If the element is oxygen, add sixteen. If the element is unrecognized, ignore it and continue. For example, an input string of carbon oxygen oxygen returns an integer mass of forty four.

title: Echo Sounder Depth Mapper
spec: Map the seabed using echo sounder ping data. Write the function `map(pings)` taking a list of integer depth readings. Loop through the readings to classify the terrain. If a reading is exactly zero, skip it as a sensor error. If a reading is greater than the previous reading by fifty meters or more, increment a cliff counter. If a reading is less than the previous reading by fifty meters or more, increment a trench counter. If three consecutive readings are completely identical, increment a flat seabed counter. If a reading exceeds the maximum sensor range of one thousand, clamp its value to one thousand before comparing. If a reading is negative, treat it as a surface reflection and ignore it. If the total number of consecutive errors exceeds five, stop processing immediately. If the total distance mapped reaches ten thousand meters, terminate the loop. For example, depth readings of 100, 160, 220 increment the cliff counter twice.

title: Matryoshka Doll Inventory Counter
spec: Count items in a nested inventory of Matryoshka dolls. Write the function `count(dolls)` taking a nested list structure. Use a stack to process the items iteratively. Loop while the stack is not empty by popping an item. If the item is a string equal to hollow, add one to the total count and push its inner contents to the stack. If the item is a string equal to solid, add one to the count but push nothing. If the item is marked as damaged, skip counting it. If the item is completely empty, ignore it. If the nesting depth exceeds twenty levels, record an anomaly flag. If the item is an integer, treat it as a batch of identical solid dolls and add that number to the count. If the item is a duplicate identifier, discard it. If a solid doll mistakenly contains items, set an error flag to true. For example, a list containing two hollow and one solid yields a count of three.

title: Debate Tournament Speaker Scorer
spec: Score speakers in a debate tournament. Write the function `score(speeches)` taking a list of tuples representing speech duration in minutes, number of interruptions, and vocabulary difficulty score. Loop through the speeches starting with a baseline score of one hundred for each. If the duration exceeds ten minutes, deduct five points. If the duration is under three minutes, deduct ten points. If the interruptions exceed five, penalize the score by twenty points. If the vocabulary score is over ninety, add a bonus of fifteen points. If the speaker yields their time exactly at five minutes, add a courtesy bonus of ten points. If the duration is precisely zero, assign a final score of zero immediately. If the final calculated score exceeds one hundred, cap it at one hundred. If the calculated score falls below zero, reset it to zero. For example, a speech of twelve minutes with six interruptions returns a score of seventy five.

title: Pneumatic Tube Message Router
spec: Route capsules in a hospital pneumatic tube system. Write the function `route(capsules)` taking a list of tuples representing capsule color string and weight integer. Maintain counts for emergency, logistics, administration, and rejected. Loop through the capsules. If the color is red, increment the emergency count. If the color is blue and the weight is greater than five, increment logistics. If the color is green, increment administration. If the color is yellow, increment logistics regardless of weight. If the weight exceeds ten, mark the capsule as rejected due to jam risk. If the weight is less than one, reject it as an empty capsule. If a third tuple element flags the item as fragile, route it to emergency instead of its normal destination. If more than three capsules are rejected consecutively, halt the routing system entirely. For example, a red capsule of weight two goes to emergency.

title: Clockwork Music Box Pin Validator
spec: Validate the pinned cylinder of a clockwork music box. Write the function `validate(cylinder)` taking a list of integer pairs representing millisecond timing and musical note pitch. Loop through the pins. If a pitch is outside the range of twenty to eighty, mark it as invalid. If the timing difference between consecutive pins is exactly zero, increment a chord counter. If a detected chord contains more than four simultaneous notes, flag a jam risk. If the timing gap exceeds ten thousand milliseconds, increment a long rest counter. If a pitch is negative, treat it as a missing pin and skip it. If the total song duration exceeds three minutes, stop evaluating. If the timing goes backwards, record a mechanical error. If the very first pin starts at a timing greater than zero, flag a delayed start. For example, consecutive pitches of forty and forty five with a zero timing gap register as one chord.

title: Asteroid Mining Yield
spec: Calculate expected yields from asteroid mining operations. Write the function `mine(asteroids)` taking a list of tuples detailing composition string, mass integer, and a scanned boolean. Loop through the items. If the scanned status is false, skip the asteroid completely. If the composition is iron, add the mass to the metals tally. If the composition is ice, add the mass to the water tally. If the composition is gold, add triple the mass to the metals tally. If the mass is greater than one thousand, apply a ten percent extraction penalty to the yielded amount. If the composition is alien, set a quarantine flag to true and halt processing. If the asteroid emits radiation, discard it without mining. If the mass is exactly zero, ignore it. For example, a scanned iron asteroid of mass five hundred adds five hundred to the metals tally.

title: Morse Code Decoder
spec: Decode a noisy Morse code transmission. Write the function `decode(signal)` taking a string of characters. Maintain a current sequence string and a decoded message list. Loop through the characters. If the character is a period, append a dot to the sequence. If the character is a hyphen, append a dash to the sequence. If the character is a single space, convert the current sequence to a letter using a standard mapping and reset the sequence. If the character is an asterisk, treat it as a triple space and append a word break to the message. If the character is an exclamation mark, discard the current sequence as a glitch. If the sequence grows longer than six dots and dashes, clear it as invalid noise. If the signal ends while a sequence is still building, convert the remainder. If the final message length exceeds one hundred words, truncate it. For example, period hyphen space decodes to the letter a.

title: Commission Sales Tier Evaluator
spec: Evaluate commission tiers for a sales team. Write the function `commission(sales)` taking a list of tuples containing product category string and sale amount integer. Loop through the sales. If the category is software, add twenty percent of the amount to the commission total. If the category is hardware, add ten percent to the total. If the category is services, add fifteen percent. If the sale amount is over ten thousand, add a flat five hundred bonus. If the sale amount is under one hundred, deduct ten as a processing fee. If the customer is marked as new in a third tuple element, add an extra fifty bonus. If the sale was refunded, subtract the entire amount from the previously calculated total. If the final accumulated commission exceeds five thousand, apply a maximum cap of five thousand. For example, a hardware sale of two hundred adds twenty to the commission.

title: Knots and Splices Rope Evaluator
spec: Assess the strength of various sailing knots and splices. Write the function `evaluate(ropes)` taking a list of tuples containing material string, thickness integer, and knot type string. Loop through the items. If the material is nylon, set the base strength to one hundred. If the material is hemp, set the base strength to sixty. If the knot is a bowline, retain eighty percent of the base strength. If the knot is a square knot, retain only fifty percent. If the knot is a figure eight, retain ninety percent. If the thickness is less than five millimeters, deduct a safety margin of ten points. If a fourth tuple element indicates the rope is wet, deduct five additional points. If the rope is frayed, halve the final calculated strength. For example, nylon material with a square knot returns a final strength of fifty.

title: Origami Crease Pattern Validator
spec: Verify the crease pattern for an origami model. Write the function `verify(creases)` taking a list of tuples with angle integer and direction string. Loop through the creases. If the angle is exactly ninety and the direction is mountain, mark it as a valid primary fold. If the angle is forty five and the direction is valley, mark it as a valid diagonal fold. If three consecutive creases have the identical direction, increment a paper tension counter. If the tension counter exceeds three, set a torn paper flag to true. If the angle is zero, ignore the crease entirely. If the angle is one hundred and eighty, mark it as a flat reference line. If the direction is unknown, record a pattern error. If a fold falls exactly on the edge of the paper, flag it as redundant. For example, an angle of ninety and mountain direction is counted as a valid fold.

title: Crystal Lattice Defect Counter
spec: Inspect a crystal lattice for atomic defects. Write the function `inspect(lattice)` taking a list of tuples containing an integer coordinate and an atomic size integer. Loop through the atoms. If an expected coordinate is completely missing an atom, increment the vacancy defect counter. If the atomic size is larger than ten, increment the interstitial defect counter. If an entire row of coordinates is shifted by one, mark a line defect. If two defects occur at adjacent coordinates, increment a severe fracture counter. If the atom is an impurity element, add it to a separate contamination tally. If the crystal boundary is reached, stop the inspection early. If the atomic size is negative, flag a critical sensor error. If the temperature coordinate is absolute zero, ignore size fluctuations. For example, a missing atom at a coordinate adds one to the vacancy defect tally.

title: Feng Shui Room Assessor
spec: Assess the harmony of a room based on furniture placement. Write the function `assess(room)` taking a list of tuples representing furniture type, color, and compass direction. Loop through the items starting with a harmony score of zero. If the item is a mirror and faces the main door, deduct five points. If the item is a bed and faces north, add three points. If the item is a water fountain and is placed in the south, deduct two points. If a sharp corner points to the room center, deduct four points. If a plant is marked as dying, deduct three points. If a red item is placed in the east, add two points. If a large wardrobe blocks a window, deduct six points. If the layout achieves perfect symmetry, add a ten point bonus at the end. For example, a bed facing north adds three points to the final harmony integer.

title: Banknote Serial Number Authenticator
spec: Authenticate the serial number of a vintage banknote. Write the function `authenticate(serial)` taking a single string. Start a running sum at zero. Loop through the characters using an index. If the character is a letter, convert it to its alphabetical integer position and add it to the sum. If the character is a digit, add its integer value to the sum. If the index position is an even number, multiply the character value by two before adding. If the final sum ends in a zero, flag the number as mathematically valid. If the string length is not exactly ten characters, mark it as invalid. If a special symbol is encountered, immediately flag the note as counterfeit. If the serial starts with a leading zero, deduct five from the sum. If the note is valid but heavily damaged, add a low condition flag. For example, a ten digit mathematically valid serial without letters returns true.

title: Gala Dinner Seating Assigner
spec: Assign seating for guests at a charity gala dinner. Write the function `seat(guests)` taking a list of guest tuples containing name, status string, and dietary string. Maintain lists for table one, table two, and an overflow table. Loop through the guests. If the status is VIP, assign them to table one. If the dietary restriction is a nut allergy, flag the guest for special kitchen handling. If the status is media, assign them to table two. If table one reaches its maximum capacity of eight, redirect subsequent VIPs to the overflow table. If the guest is a child, assign them to a separate playroom list. If the guest is the keynote speaker, reserve the first seat at table one. If the guest arrives late, send them straight to the overflow table. If the guest is uninvited, reject their entry completely. For example, a VIP guest is appended to the table one list.

title: Pottery Wheel Glaze Applicator
spec: Control an automated glaze applicator for a pottery wheel. Write the function `glaze(pots)` taking a list of tuples detailing clay type, glaze chemical, and drying time. Loop through the batch. If the clay is porcelain, flag it for high temperature firing. If the glaze chemical contains lead, reject the pot immediately. If the clay is terracotta, apply a double layer of glaze. If the drying time is under twenty four hours, mark it as fragile. If the glaze is a metallic finish, extend the drying time by twelve hours. If the pot has visible cracks, discard it to the recycle bin. If the pot weighs over five kilograms, flag it for heavy lifting transport. If the batch exceeds fifty pots, pause the machine for maintenance. For example, a pot with a lead glaze is immediately rejected and discarded.

title: Hot Air Balloon Weight Balancer
spec: Balance the passenger weight in a hot air balloon basket. Write the function `balance(passengers)` taking a list of tuples containing integer weight, a VIP boolean, and a pregnant boolean. Loop through the queue. If a weight is over one hundred, assign them to the center of the basket. If a weight is under fifty, pair them with another light passenger on the edge. If adding the next person exceeds the maximum lift capacity of five hundred, leave them and all subsequent passengers behind. If the VIP status is true, guarantee their boarding by prioritizing them first. If the pregnant status is true, assign them a seated position. If the high wind condition is active, artificially reduce the lift capacity by twenty percent before loading. If a passenger weight is exactly zero, deny them boarding. If the basket is completely empty at launch, cancel the flight. For example, a VIP passenger weighing eighty kilograms boards first.

title: Volcanic Ash Plume Tracker
spec: Track a volcanic ash plume to issue aviation warnings. Write the function `track(reports)` taking a list of daily atmospheric tuples containing altitude in kilometers, silica percentage, a wind shift boolean, and a rain boolean. Loop through the reports. If the altitude exceeds ten kilometers, issue a red alert to ground all flights. If the silica content is over fifty percent, issue a public health warning. If the wind shift is true, expand the alert radius by fifty miles. If the altitude is zero for three consecutive days, lower the alert level to green. If the rain boolean is true, reduce the airborne ash concentration factor. If the altitude is exactly five, issue a standard aviation advisory. If the altitude is negative, ignore the reading as a sensor error. If zero visibility is reported, halt all ground transport. For example, an altitude reading of twelve generates a red alert string.

title: Camel Caravan Water Planner
spec: Plan water consumption for a camel caravan crossing different terrains. Write the function `plan(route)` taking a list of terrain strings. The caravan starts with one hundred liters of water. Loop through the route segments. If the terrain is desert, subtract five liters from the supply. If the terrain is an oasis, refill the supply back to the maximum of one hundred. If the terrain is mountain, subtract eight liters due to exertion. If a sandstorm occurs, halt progress for the day and subtract two liters. If the water supply drops strictly below zero at any point, the mission fails immediately. If the terrain is a river crossing, water is not consumed but travel time increases. If a severe heatwave is active, double the water consumption for that specific segment. If a bandit attack is flagged, ten liters are lost due to spilled supplies. For example, traversing a desert and then a mountain leaves eighty seven liters.

title: Mineral Identification Classifier
spec: Write a function `classify(minerals)` that takes a list of tuples, each containing a color string, a hardness number, a luster string, and a streak string. Iterate over the list to identify each mineral. If the hardness is ten, the mineral is diamond. If the luster is metallic and the streak is grey, it is galena. If the hardness is less than three and the color is yellow, it is sulfur. If the hardness is seven and the color is purple, it is amethyst. If the hardness is seven and the color is clear, it is quartz. If the streak is red, it is hematite. If the luster is pearly, it is talc. If the color is blue, it is azurite. If the hardness is nine, it is corundum. Return a list of identified mineral strings, substituting unknown for any that do not match these criteria. For example, given an input containing a tuple of clear, seven, glassy, and white, return a list containing quartz.

title: Scuba Dive Decompression Planner
spec: Create a function `plan(dives)` that accepts a list of tuples representing a depth in meters and a time in minutes. Loop through the dives while keeping a running nitrogen load starting at zero. If the depth is greater than thirty, add a severity penalty of twenty to the load. If the time is greater than forty five, add a duration penalty of ten. If the depth is less than ten, subtract five from the load. If the time is less than twenty, subtract two from the load. If the running load exceeds one hundred, a safety stop is required. If a safety stop is required and the time is over sixty, the dive is considered dangerous. If consecutive deep dives occur where depth is over twenty five twice in a row, flag the status as restricted. If the load ever drops below zero, reset it to zero. Return a list of status strings for each dive such as safe, stop required, dangerous, or restricted.

title: Virtual Pet Status Manager
spec: Develop a function `update(actions)` that accepts a list of action strings to manage a digital pet. The pet starts with five points each for hunger, happiness, and energy. Loop through the actions sequentially. If the action is feed, decrease hunger by two and increase energy by one. If the action is play, increase happiness by two and decrease energy by two. If the action is sleep, restore energy to ten and increase hunger by one. If the action is scold, decrease happiness by three. Check the pet state after each action: if hunger exceeds eight, the pet is starving and happiness drops to zero. If energy falls below two, the pet is exhausted. If happiness is below three, the pet is sad. If hunger drops below zero, reset it to zero. Return a tuple of the final hunger, happiness, and energy integers.

title: Rock Climbing Grade Converter
spec: Write a module with a function `convert(routes)` that processes a list of climbing grade strings. Iterate through the routes to categorize their difficulty. If the route starts with five, it is Yosemite decimal. If it is Yosemite and ends with a letter, it is a hard route. If it starts with a capital V, it is a bouldering grade. If it is a bouldering grade and the number is greater than ten, it is elite. If the route contains a plus sign, it is a stiff grade. If it contains a minus sign, it is soft. If it starts with a letter, it is British traditional. If the route length descriptor is short, it is a sprint. If the route contains a slash, it is a split grade. Return a list of categorized difficulty strings.

title: Tea Brewing Guide
spec: Implement a function `brew(teas)` that takes a list of tuples containing a tea family string, a leaf style string, and an age in years. Loop over the teas to determine the brewing temperature. If the family is green, the baseline temperature is eighty. If the family is green and the style is powdered, lower the temperature to seventy. If the family is black, the temperature is ninety five. If the family is black and the style is broken, the temperature is ninety. If the family is oolong and the age is greater than five, the temperature is one hundred. If the family is white, the temperature is eighty five. If the family is white and the style is buds, the temperature is seventy five. If the family is herbal, the temperature is always one hundred. If the family is yellow, the temperature is eighty. Return a list of the calculated integer temperatures.

title: Wood Density and Usage Evaluator
spec: Write a function `evaluate(samples)` taking a list of tuples with a species string, a moisture percentage, and a density number. Iterate through the samples to determine their best use. If the moisture is greater than twenty, the result is kiln drying needed. If the moisture is less than six, the result is too dry. If the density is greater than eight hundred, the result is flooring. If the density is between five hundred and eight hundred and the species is oak, the result is furniture. If the density is less than four hundred and the species is balsa, the result is modeling. If the species is pine and the moisture is acceptable, the result is framing. If the density is extreme, the result is specialty turning. If the species is mahogany, the result is fine cabinetry. Return a list of the usage strings.

title: Medieval Jousting Tournament Scorer
spec: Develop a function `score(passes)` that accepts a list of tuples containing a knight color string, a hit location string, and an unhorsed boolean. Track the scores for a red knight and a blue knight starting at zero. Loop through the passes to assign points. If the knight is red, update the red score. If the knight is blue, update the blue score. If the hit location is a shield, add one point. If the hit location is a helmet, add two points. If the hit location is the chest, add three points. If the hit location is a miss, award zero points. If the unhorsed boolean is true, add five points. If either score exceeds ten, end the match early and stop processing passes. Return the final scores as a tuple containing the red score and the blue score.

title: Book Condition Grader
spec: Create a function `grade(books)` that processes a list of tuples representing spine creases, page tears, a markings boolean, and a water damage boolean. Process each book to determine its physical condition. If water damage is true, the condition is poor. If page tears are greater than five, the condition is fair. If spine creases are zero and markings are false and tears are zero, the condition is mint. If spine creases are less than three and no tears exist, the condition is very good. If markings are true but no tears exist and spine creases are less than five, the condition is good. If spine creases exceed ten, the condition is a reading copy. If tears are exactly one, apply a minor deduction by downgrading one level. If the book is an ex library copy indicated by a specific marking, the condition is automatically acceptable. Return a list of condition strings.

title: Honey Quality Assessor
spec: Write a function `assess(samples)` that takes a list of tuples containing a floral source string, a water content number, and a color string. Process each sample to determine its quality status. If the water content is greater than twenty, the status is fermenting. If the water content is less than fifteen, the status is premium thick. If the source is clover and the color is light, the status is classic. If the source is buckwheat and the color is dark, the status is robust. If the source is manuka, the status is medicinal. If the color is amber and the water content is normal, the status is standard table honey. If the color is white, the status is delicate. If the sample is crystallized, note it as raw processing. Return a list of the status strings.

title: Antique Clock Valuer
spec: Implement a function `value(clocks)` that accepts a list of tuples containing a maker string, a year integer, a condition string, and a working boolean. Calculate the monetary value for each clock starting with a base of one hundred. If the maker is famous, add one thousand to the value. If the maker is unknown, subtract fifty. If the year is before eighteen hundred, multiply the value by two. If the year is after nineteen fifty, divide the value by two. If the condition is mint, add five hundred. If the condition is poor, subtract two hundred. If the working boolean is false, cut the value in half. If the working boolean is true and the condition is mint, add a special bonus of three hundred. Return a list of the final integer values.

title: Maple Syrup Grader
spec: Create a function `grade(syrups)` taking a list of tuples containing a transmittance number and a flavor string. Loop over the syrups to determine their classification. If the transmittance is greater than seventy five, the grade is golden. If the transmittance is between fifty and seventy five, the grade is amber. If the transmittance is between twenty five and fifty, the grade is dark. If the transmittance is less than twenty five, the grade is very dark. If the flavor is sour, the grade is processing grade regardless of color. If the flavor is excellent and transmittance is very high, the grade is premium golden. If the flavor is strong and the color is amber, flag the syrup as irregular. If the transmittance is exactly one hundred, the syrup is completely clear and likely artificial. Return a list of grade strings.

title: Sewing Stitch Selector
spec: Develop a function `select(fabrics)` that accepts a list of tuples containing a weight number, a stretch number, and a structural boolean. Process each fabric to choose the best stitch. If the stretch is greater than twenty, the stitch is stretch zigzag. If the stretch is between ten and twenty, the stitch is narrow zigzag. If the weight is greater than three hundred and the structural boolean is true, the stitch is heavy straight. If the weight is less than one hundred, the stitch is micro straight. If the structural boolean is false and the weight is medium, the stitch is basting. If the weight is extreme, the stitch is industrial double. If the stretch is zero and the structural boolean is true, the stitch is standard straight. If the structural boolean is false and stretch is zero, the stitch is decorative. Return a list of the selected stitch strings.

title: Bread Dough Hydration Calculator
spec: Write a function `calculate(recipes)` taking a list of tuples containing a flour weight, a water weight, and a flour type string. Iterate through the recipes and calculate the percentage of water to flour. If the flour type is rye, the target hydration is eighty. If the flour type is whole wheat, the target is seventy five. If the flour type is bread, the target is seventy. If the flour type is pastry, the target is sixty. If the hydration is below the target by more than five, the result is add water. If the hydration is above the target by more than five, the result is add flour. If the hydration is exactly equal to the target, the result is perfect. If the difference is greater than twenty, the result is extreme and should be rejected. If the flour type is gluten free, the target is ninety. Return a list of result strings.

title: Bird Feeder Seed Selector
spec: Implement a function `recommend(birds)` that accepts a list of bird species strings. Iterate through the birds to track the necessary seed types in a collection. If the bird is a cardinal, add black oil sunflower. If the bird is a goldfinch, add nyjer. If the bird is a woodpecker, add suet. If the bird is a mourning dove, add white proso millet. If the bird is a jay, add peanuts. If the bird is a hummingbird, add nectar. If the bird is a sparrow, add cracked corn. If the bird is a crow, add whole corn. If the collection grows to contain more than four different seed types, clear it and recommend a premium mixed blend instead. Return a list of the recommended seed strings.

title: Vintage Camera Lens Evaluator
spec: Create a function `evaluate(lenses)` that takes a list of tuples containing a mount string, a fungus boolean, a scratches number, and a focal length number. Evaluate each lens to determine its condition and type. If the fungus boolean is true, the condition is salvage. If scratches are greater than five, the condition is poor. If the mount is proprietary, add a note that an adapter is required. If the focal length is less than thirty five, the type is wide angle. If the focal length is greater than eighty five, the type is telephoto. If scratches are zero and fungus is false, the condition is mint. If the focal length is exactly fifty, the type is standard prime. If the mount string says broken, the condition requires servicing. Return a list of strings combining the condition and type.

title: Motorcycle Helmet Sizer
spec: Write a function `size(measurements)` that accepts a list of tuples containing a circumference number, a shape string, and a riding style string. Determine the fit for each rider. If the circumference is less than fifty four, the size is small. If the circumference is greater than sixty, the size is large. If the circumference is average, the size is medium. If the shape is round, recommend brand alpha. If the shape is oval, recommend brand beta. If the style is racing, the fit is aggressive snug. If the style is touring, the fit is relaxed comfort. If the style is offroad, recommend goggles compatibility. If the style is commuting, modular helmets are preferred. Return a list of strings detailing the size and fit recommendations.

title: Hot Sauce Scoville Classifier
spec: Develop a function `classify(sauces)` taking a list of tuples containing a pepper string, a dilution number, and an extract boolean. Process each sauce to assign a heat category. If the extract boolean is true, the category is ultra hot warning. If the pepper is reaper, the category is extreme. If the pepper is habanero and the dilution is less than ten, the category is very hot. If the pepper is jalapeno and the dilution is low, the category is medium. If the pepper is poblano, the category is mild. If the dilution is greater than fifty, reduce the heat category by one step. If the extract is true and the pepper is reaper, the category is biological weapon. If the sauce is completely sweet, the category is zero heat. If garlic is heavily added, note it as savory. Return a list of category strings.

title: Bonsai Tree Pruning Guide
spec: Implement a function `prune(trees)` that accepts a list of tuples containing a species string, a season string, and a thickness number. Provide instructions for each tree. If the species is pine and the season is spring, the action is pinch candles. If the species is maple and the season is winter, the action is structural prune. If the species is juniper and the season is summer, the action is thin foliage. If the thickness is greater than two, add a step to apply cut paste. If the season is autumn and the species is deciduous, the action is minimal trim. If the tree is flowering and the season is spring, delay pruning to protect buds. If the thickness is extreme, the action requires using a handsaw. If roots are exposed, add a step to repot. Return a list of the action strings.

title: Pearl Quality Grader
spec: Create a function `grade(pearls)` that takes a list of tuples containing a shape string, a luster string, a blemishes number, and a size number. Grade each pearl based on its characteristics. If the shape is perfectly round, the base grade is high. If the shape is baroque, the base grade is designer. If the luster is metallic, add a premium flag. If the luster is dull, subtract a grade level. If blemishes are greater than five, the grade is commercial. If blemishes are zero, the grade is flawless. If the size is greater than twelve, flag the pearl as rare. If the size is less than five, flag it as a seed pearl. If the pearl is dyed, automatically assign a commercial grade. Return a list of final grades.

title: Vinyl Record Cleaning Strategy
spec: Write a function `clean(records)` that accepts a list of tuples containing a dust level string, a fingerprints number, and a scratches number. Determine the cleaning method for each record. If scratches are greater than three, the method is skip track. If the dust level is heavy, the method is vacuum machine. If fingerprints are greater than five, the method is wet wash. If the dust level is light and fingerprints are zero, the method is carbon fiber brush. If the dust level is extreme, the method is ultrasonic bath. If scratches are zero and dust is none, the method is play directly. If fingerprints are exactly one, the method is a microfiber cloth wipe. If the record is moldy, the method is enzyme soak. Return a list of the chosen methods.

title: Cheese Fondue Stabilizer
spec: Develop a function `stabilize(pots)` taking a list of tuples containing a cheese age number, an acidity number, and a texture string. Diagnose each fondue pot to fix its consistency. If the texture is stringy, the solution is add lemon juice. If the texture is broken, the solution is add cornstarch slurry. If the texture is solid, the solution is add warm wine. If the cheese age is greater than twenty, the solution requires extra moisture. If the acidity is less than three, the solution requires white wine. If the texture is perfect but the age is young, the solution is simmer gently. If the texture is greasy, the solution is add dry mustard. If the pot is scorched on the bottom, the solution is transfer to a new pot. Return a list of the solution strings.

title: Fountain Pen Ink Selector
spec: Implement a function `select(preferences)` that accepts a list of tuples containing a paper string, a speed string, and a permanence boolean. Select an ink for each set of preferences. If the paper is cheap, the ink type is a dry formulation. If the paper is premium, the ink type is wet flowing. If the speed is fast, the ink type is quick dry. If the speed is slow, the ink type is high sheen. If the permanence boolean is true, the ink type is iron gall. If the ink type is iron gall, add a warning that a gold nib is required. If the permanence is false and the paper is cheap, the ink type is standard dye. If shimmer is desired, warn about clogging. If the writer is left handed, recommend fast drying over sheen. Return a list of ink types and warnings.

title: Watch Movement Servicer
spec: Create a function `service(watches)` that takes a list of tuples containing an amplitude number, a beat error number, and a daily rate number. Analyze each watch to determine the necessary service actions. If the amplitude is less than two hundred, the action is full overhaul. If the amplitude is greater than three hundred, the action is check for knocking. If the beat error is greater than one, the action is adjust stud carrier. If the daily rate is greater than twenty, the action is regulate length. If the daily rate is less than negative twenty, the action is speed up. If the beat error is zero and the amplitude is excellent, the action is close case. If the daily rate is highly erratic, the action is demagnetize. If the watch is vintage, use specialized gentle tools. If the watch is water damaged, replace all seals. Return a list of the service actions.
